description:
The unsigned calldata to take fund shares back from Blue: withdrawCollateral(marketParams, shares, account, account), with the
        post-action HF / LTV and the 70%-of-LLTV warning. Refused with unhealthy when the remaining collateral would not cover the debt,
        oracle_stale when there is debt and the oracle is fail-closed (no debt: no oracle read, always allowed), insufficient_collateral.
        You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: borrow_withdraw_collateral_quote
